description.zh: 一周的课程表：教室、颜色和一条实时的「现在」线——点空格加课，也可以把整张表粘进来
description.en: A weekly class timetable with rooms, colours and a live now line — click a slot, or paste the whole week in

help.zh: 藏起来的那几天的课还在——切到「周一 – 周六」或「周一 – 周日」就能看见。
help.en: Classes on hidden days are kept — switch to Mon – Sat or Mon – Sun to see them.

help.zh: 卡片上的第一个整点。更早开始的课会自动把范围撑开。
help.en: The first hour on the card. A class that starts earlier expands the range automatically.

help.zh: 卡片上的最后一个整点。更晚结束的课会自动把范围撑开。
help.en: The last hour on the card. A class that ends later expands the range automatically.

help.zh: 第 1 周的那个周一，用来算单双周。留空就每周都显示全部课程。
help.en: The Monday of week 1, used for odd / even weeks. Leave empty to show every class every week.

items.zh: 点网格里的空格子，或者顶栏的 +。编辑器打开时，那一天和那个时间已经填好了。
items.en: Click an empty slot in the grid, or the + in the top bar. The editor opens with that day and time already filled in.

items.zh: 给它一个名字、教室、开始和结束。时间写成 09:30，写 9:30 也认。
items.en: Give it a name, a room, a start and an end. Times look like 09:30; 9:30 also works.

items.zh: 点「保存」或按回车存下。按 Escape 关掉编辑器，不保存。
items.en: Save with the button or Enter. Escape closes the editor without saving.

items.zh: 从教务系统或 Excel 里复制一整片区域，点顶栏那颗向下箭头粘进去：一行一节课，列依次是课程、星期、开始、结束、教室、周次。
items.en: Copy the whole grid from Excel or your school's system and paste it with the arrow button: one class per line — name, day, start, end, room, weeks.

items.zh: 星期写 1–7 或周一，周次写 单 / 双，留空就是每周。读不出来的行会跳过去，不会让整张表失败。
items.en: Day is 1–7 or Mon, weeks is odd / even, blank means every week. Rows that cannot be read are skipped instead of failing the whole paste.

items.zh: 已经在表里的课（同名、同一天、同一段时间）不会再加一遍——按钮上那个数字就是真正会多出来的节数。
items.en: Classes already on the timetable (same name, day and times) are not added twice — the number on the button is what will really be added.

items.zh: 列是星期几，行是小时。表头写着这一周的日期，今天用强调色标出来。
items.en: Columns are weekdays, rows are hours. The header shows this week's dates, and today is marked in the accent colour.

items.zh: 今天那一列上横着一条细线，就是现在；正在上的课会加一圈描边。
items.en: A thin line across today's column is the current time; a class under it is outlined.

items.zh: 颜色在编辑器里自己挑——六种色在浅色和深色底板上都看得清。
items.en: Colours are yours to choose in the editor — six tints that work on both light and dark boards.

items.zh: 点课程块就能改。点「删除」立刻删掉，没有撤销。
items.en: Click a class block to edit it. Delete removes it immediately; there is no undo.

items.zh: 同一时间的两节课并排站，不会互相盖住。
items.en: Two classes at the same time sit side by side instead of covering each other.

items.zh: 很短的课会藏起教室那一行，把地方留给名字。
items.en: Short classes hide the room line so the name stays readable.

items.zh: 「显示哪几天」「一天从几点开始」「一天到几点结束」都在属性面板里，按每一份单独调。
items.en: Days shown, Day starts at and Day ends at are in the inspector, per copy.

items.zh: 选定时段之外的课会把整周的范围撑开——不会有课被悄悄裁掉。
items.en: A class outside the chosen hours expands the range for the whole week — nothing is silently cut off.

items.zh: 藏起来的那几天的课还在存储里，没有被删掉。
items.en: Classes on hidden days stay in storage; they are not deleted.

items.zh: 把「开学日期」填成第 1 周的那个周一，再在编辑器里选「每周」「单周」或「双周」。
items.en: Set Term starts to the Monday of week 1, then pick Every week, Odd weeks or Even weeks in the editor.

items.zh: 卡片显示当前这一周；不属于这一周的课先藏起来，等轮到那一周再出现。
items.en: The card shows the current week; classes for the other parity stay hidden until that week comes around.

items.zh: 「开学日期」留空时，每周都显示全部课程——单双周直接忽略，不去猜。
items.en: With Term starts empty, every class is shown every week — parity is ignored rather than guessed.

items.zh: 写盘失败时，周次会变成「未保存」——通常是缺了存储权限。
items.en: The week label switches to Not saved when a write fails — usually a missing storage permission.

items.zh: 在能重新写盘之前，课表还在内存里照常能用；去属性面板授予存储权限，再改一次就好。
items.en: The timetable keeps working in memory until it can write again; grant storage in the inspector and edit once more.

items.zh: 什么都不上传。没有账号，也不需要联网权限。
items.en: Nothing is uploaded anywhere. There is no account and no network permission.

changes.zh: 顶栏多了一颗粘贴导入：从 Excel 或教务系统复制一整片区域，一行一节课，读不出来的行跳过并报数。
changes.en: A paste-import button in the top bar: copy a whole grid from Excel, one class per line, unreadable rows are skipped and counted.

changes.zh: 已经在表里的课不会重复加；按钮上写着真正会多出来的节数。
changes.en: Classes already on the timetable are never added twice; the button says how many will really be added.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：列头写「周一」…「周五」，编辑器、按钮、空态和提示也都跟着换。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: columns read 周一…周五, and the editor, buttons, empty states and messages follow.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：周视图网格，点一下加课，带教室、六种颜色和一条实时的「现在」线。
changes.en: First release: weekly grid with click-to-add classes, rooms, six colours and a live now line.

changes.zh: 点一节课就能改或删；重叠的课分享同一列。
changes.en: Click a class to edit or delete it; overlapping classes share the column.

changes.zh: 用「开学日期」支持单双周，另外显示哪几天和时段范围都按每一份单独调。
changes.en: Odd / even week support through Term starts, plus per-copy day range and visible days.
